summary.text: Michele Clark is the Democratic candidate for the Illinois State Senate, District 33, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Danielle Penman for a seat with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign described her as a small business owner and nonprofit leader who ran an early childhood learning center in McHenry County for more than a decade.

paragraphs.text: Michele Clark lives in Algonquin with her husband, a commercial airline pilot, and they have two college-age daughters, according to her Ballotpedia survey response.
The survey response says she ran a large early childhood learning center in McHenry County for more than a decade and later served as chief operating officer of the Boys & Girls Club NWS.
It adds that she currently raises funds for the D300 Food Pantry.
Clark advanced unopposed from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026, with 20,399 votes.
Her survey response says she wants to make Illinois more affordable and would work across the aisle when it makes sense.
